profileEvidence.summary: Friendly, willing and active, the Lucas Terrier is a sturdy small dog developed for terrier work. Sir Jocelyn Lucas began the line in the 1940s by crossing a Norfolk Terrier with one of his Ilmer Sealyhams. The original club continues to preserve those Ilmer bloodlines through a small breeding programme.

profileEvidence.summary: Good-natured yet energetic and persistent on a trail, the Lithuanian Hound combines endurance with a melodious, changing voice. Its work includes finding fresh game tracks and following wounded animals, tasks that draw on keen scent and good orientation. The modern breed was rebuilt from surviving local hounds beginning in 1957–58, with a first provisional standard in 1966.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An energetic, good-natured Lithuanian hound with a melodious voice, persistent tracking and a strong sense of direction.
